source_followup.mx.1997.2.6: The displayed product of positive reciprocals is strictly less than 1/5 and cannot equal one. Check whether addition signs were lost in the stored equation.
source_followup.mx.2000.1.3: The signed-sum construction does not state whether an element may be used more than once. With repetition allowed, A={1} already generates every positive integer. Check the intended restriction.
source_followup.mx.2001.2.4: Congruence alone does not specify the next term of the sequence or its alternating sum. Check the representative convention and the order of the arguments in f(m,n).
source_followup.mx.2007.2.6: The hypotheses as stored do not exclude D=B, which satisfies CD=BC but violates BD=AC. Check the position restriction on D and whether another geometric condition is missing.
source_followup.mx.2015.2.4: Erasing all but one entry in each of n cubed triples leaves n cubed entries. For n=4 the count is 64, a square. Check whether the sum of the surviving values, rather than their count, was intended.
source_followup.mx.2018.1.1: The position restriction on X does not clearly exclude the midpoint M, where MX=0 cannot exceed XY. Check the full position conditions and the direction of the inequality.
source_followup.mx.2022.0.3: No duration bound for the performance is given. Instruments can play separately for arbitrarily long times, so the displayed sonority has no finite maximum. Check the missing time restriction.
source_followup.ar.1994.0.5: Rotation by zero preserves every set satisfying the other conditions but is omitted from the claimed list. Check the nonidentity assumption and the normalization of the rotation angle.
source_followup.vn.1972.0.2: Point G in line FG is never defined. Check the missing construction before interpreting the incidence claim.
source_followup.vn.1980.1.1: For n=1 and alpha=3pi/2, the cosine condition gives the odd integer one, while the sine sum is minus one. Check the angular interval or an omitted absolute value.
source_followup.vn.1985.1.3: Edge lengths alone do not determine the requested section area of a general parallelepiped. Check whether the original solid was explicitly rectangular.
source_followup.vn.1987.2.5: The bounded differentiable function f(x)=sqrt(10-2cos x) satisfies ff prime=sin x and |f|<5 but has no limit at infinity. Check the differential inequality or its right-hand side.
source_followup.vn.1991.2.5: For an equilateral triangle of circumradius one, GD=GE=GF=1, so the displayed middle inequality would assert 3<=sqrt(3). Check the missing scale factor or incorrectly placed inequality terms.
source_followup.vn.1993.2.4: The claimed minimizing condition fails as stored. On the unit sphere take A=(0,0,1) and B,C,D equally spaced on its equator: the expression is -3. If the three edges from A are mutually perpendicular the expression is zero. Check the extremum direction or the expression.
source_followup.vn.1995.1.2: The recurrence is stated only for n>=2, leaving a_2 and a_3 unspecified despite giving just a_0 and a_1. Check its lower index or missing initial terms.
source_followup.vn.2005.1.2: As written, both circles pass through A,B and are tangent at C, so both contain A,B,C and coincide. A circle through B,C also cannot be tangent to BC at C. Check which fixed point belongs to each circle.
source_followup.vn.2012.1.4: For n=2 and the order boy,boy,girl,girl, the two middle students receive two candies each, giving four, while the stated bound is two. Check the factor in the bound or the counting definition.
source_followup.vn.2017.1.4: Part (a) refers to a given five-by-five colouring, but no pattern or linked figure is stored. Obtain the original diagram.
source_followup.vn.2017.2.6: All displayed binomial coefficients vanish under the standard convention because their upper index is smaller than 2017. In part (b), the right-hand side has remainder 2156173 modulo 2017 squared and is nonzero. Check whether the binomial arguments were reversed.
source_followup.vn.2018.1.4: The last denominator in part (b) repeats x_3 instead of matching the cyclic pattern. Check that denominator and any restrictions excluding zero coordinates.
source_followup.vn.2019.1.4: Six named points are assigned respectively to only five rays. Check the missing ray and its position in the list.
source_followup.vn.2019.2.7: The stored equivalence is equality at corresponding cells, which gives n to the power 25 colourings. The claimed upper bound instead has the form of a rotation/reflection orbit count. Check the omitted equivalence operations.
